title: DGNL extraction gold: sample 40 questions, draft gold + review sheet, user corrects, extract-eval (REQ-0078)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 seeded stratified 40-question sample + draft gold + extracted file by a tested tool
AC2 review sheet with page images, editable text, JSON export
AC3 corrected gold stored, extract-eval n=40 with Wilson intervals

design.summary: tool samples 40 published DGNL questions (seeded, stratified), writes extracted + draft gold + review sheet with page images; user corrects; extract-eval n=40

implementation.summary: tools/extract_gold_draft.py build/store: seeded stratified 40-question sample of published DGNL solver inputs, extracted + draft gold + review.html (page images, editable, JSON export); real build 40 q (13/14/13), 29 pages, all stems on their pages
